Apple | SRE | San Diego | Full-time

You will work closely with developers who are building applications in Python and JavaScript, ensuring their code runs seamlessly in production. Your role will involve driving solutions for hybrid infrastructure (both on-premise and public cloud) and architecting our AWS-based platform. You will manage technologies such as Pulumi, Argo, Docker, Kubernetes, Postgres, and DataDog, combined with custom Apple software and tooling. You will oversee and enhance the CI/CD pipeline and support deployment of QA’s automated testing. You will monitor performance of the infrastructure and identify areas of improvement. You will identify infrastructure needs for new projects and coordinate with developers to ensure they are factored into the development process.

Apply here: https://jobs.apple.com/en-us/details/200648948/tools-and-pro...
